semantically_equivalent_domains.justification: Global Health Outreach involves addressing health concerns across countries or regions, synonymous with Global Health, which focuses on understanding and addressing health conditions on a global platform.
International Health closely relates to Global Health Outreach as it involves health care beyond national boundaries, making it semantically equivalent.

parent_domains.justification: This is a broad domain focusing on health issues that transcend national boundaries, into which Global Health Outreach falls.
As Global Health Outreach involves international collaboration, International Health serves as a suitable parent domain.
Public health provides a broader context under which Global Health Outreach may fall, focusing on protecting and improving the health of populations.

closest_parent_domain.justification: The domain Global Health is most closely aligned with Global Health Outreach, as it encompasses global initiatives, actions, and collaboration similar to outreach efforts.

child_domains.justification: Global Surgery focuses on surgical care in a global context, and can be considered a specific application area within digital and global health outreach initiatives.
This domain blends global surgery with policies relevant internationally, a conceptual extension of Global Health Outreach.

closest_child_domain.justification: Global Surgery is the most direct specialization within Global Health Outreach, relating directly to the implementation of surgical initiatives globally.

sibling_domains.justification: Both International Health and Global Health Outreach target health improvements across countries.
Similar to Global Health Outreach, Population Health considers the health outcomes of a group of individuals.
This domain shares the community outreach component with Global Health Outreach, focusing on primary care at the community level.

closest_sibling_domain.justification: International Health most closely aligns with Global Health Outreach, both focusing on improving health across country borders.

unrelated_domains.justification: The focus on policies specifically distinguishes it from the more action-oriented approach of Global Health Outreach.
